mentions.name: Lumeir Jobs
mentions.description: A hiring platform that aims to bring humanity back to hiring through conversation, replacing resumes with a richer, holistic interpretation of a person's achievements by letting candidates talk about their experience as the basis for how they are represented.
mentions.problem: Resumes give only a thin representation of a person's achievements, and hiring has lost its human element.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working with some friends to bring humanity back to hiring through conversation: https://lumeirjobs.com

Our vision is to replace resumes with a richer, holistic interpretation of a person's achievements by allowing them to talk about their experience and using that as a base for how they are represented.
